newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shiseido to buy part of Helene Curtis' business.
newsitem.headline: Shiseido to buy part of Helene Curtis' business.

text.p: Shiseido International Corporation, a U.S. unit of Shiseido Co Ltd, has agreed with Helene Curtis Inc, a unit of Unilever United States Inc, to buy certain assets of Helene Curtis' professional products business in the United States and Canada, Shiseido said in a statement.
It said the terms of the acquisition, which would take place before the year's end, were not disclosed.

The acquisition includes sales rights, certain trademarks and patents inventories and other assets, but the "Helene Curtis" trademark and the Helene Curtis professional product business in Japan, Australia, New Zealand and Italy are not included in the purchase, the company said.
A unit of Shiseido will assume responsibility for production and sales, Shiseido said.
